item.title: Trump announced a deal for Hamas to disarm. And, the U.S. economy slowed a bit
item.description: President Trump says a deal has been reached for Hamas to completely disarm and Israeli forces to withdraw from Gaza. And, the U.S. economy slowed some, but Americans continued to spend.
item.content:encoded:
President Trump says a deal has been reached for Hamas to completely disarm and Israeli forces to withdraw from Gaza. And, the U.S. economy slowed some, but Americans continued to spend.

(Image credit: Andrew Harnik)

item.title: Thousands in France allowed to return home as Europe tackles wildfires and heatwave
item.description: Firefighters in the Gironde region of France said the situation had "stabilized", after a week of wildfires caused by a major heatwave across Europe.

item.title: At least 18 die after breach of border between Morocco and Spanish territory of Ceuta
item.description: At least 18 migrants have died trying to reach the Spanish territory of Ceuta after thousands of people breached the frontier with Morocco and poured in. The crisis boiled over Thursday and overnight.

item.title: Trump announces deal for Hamas to disarm, militants demand Israel withdraws from Gaza first
item.description: President Trump announced that his Board of Peace has reached a deal with Hamas to completely disarm, calling it a "historic breakthrough." But a senior Hamas official says Israel must withdraw first.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: European soccer leaders to boycott the World Cup in an unprecedented step
item.description: European soccer associations said they would boycott the World Cup unless FIFA reverses a controversial deal to sell minority stakes to the marquee soccer tournament.

item.title: Sen. Paul threatens to hold Fauci in contempt. And, a new rule undercuts U.S. asylum
item.description: Sen. Rand Paul is moving to hold Dr. Anthony Fauci in contempt of Congress after he invoked his Fifth Amendment rights. And, the Trump administration has announced a new rule for the asylum process.

item.title: Russian strikes across Ukraine kill 10 and a missile falls in Poland
item.description: A Russian missile and drone barrage across Ukraine killed at least 10 civilians, including children, and NATO scrambled jets after one of the missiles crossed the border into Poland.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: The U.S. retaliates against a 'surprise attack' by Iran in Jordan
item.description: The U.S. attacks were in retaliation for what the U.S. Central Command called "an attempted surprise attack" with ballistic missiles on Tuesday against U.S. forces in the Middle East.
